verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents its own programmatic interface: an MCP server at https://api.cfo.ai/mcp with a tool reference. Through it an agent can read and change the Model (Pages, tables, formulas, Variables, Dimensions) and start or read Ari chats, with OAuth-authenticated access. However, it is MCP-only. All OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths return 404, and the docs say cfo.ai issues no API keys or access tokens, so every client must sign in as a person. That limits it as a general public API. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP API with an OpenAPI spec, API keys or service tokens for headless use, and independent hands-on corroboration.
